name: next
why: The web framework the team chose (Next.js App Router): pages, server actions, routing and the Vercel build.

name: react
why: Required by Next.js to render the pages.

name: react-dom
why: Required by Next.js to render the pages in the browser.

name: postgres
why: Talks to the Postgres database (local and Supabase's pooler) with plain SQL; a database driver cannot reasonably be hand-written.

name: geist
why: The Geist and Geist Mono fonts that docs/DESIGN.md requires, including the rounded-dot style that Google Fonts strips.

name: typescript
why: The team writes the app in TypeScript; Next.js uses it to type-check the build (6.0 rather than the brand-new 7.0 for tooling compatibility).

name: @types/node
why: Type definitions for Node.js APIs used by the server code and scripts (crypto, process).

name: @types/react
why: Type definitions for React, needed by TypeScript.

name: @types/react-dom
why: Type definitions for React DOM, needed by TypeScript.

name: tsx
why: Runs the TypeScript migration and fake-data commands directly, sharing the app's code and its import paths, without a separate build step.

name: vitest
why: Runs the automated tests of the sign-in rules and user management (FR-030).

name: @playwright/test
why: Runs the browser tests of sign-in, sign-out and the Users page; Playwright is the browser test tool the team chose.
